RuleSpec: A validation rule with its message: a rule (an expression, or a function), or { rule, message }.
FieldOptions: The options every field takes: null, default (a value or a function), unique, index, primaryKey, choices, column, validate (rules), audit, and computed, stored and uses for computed fields.
StringOptions: The options of string and text fields: maxLength and minLength (and those of every field).
NumberOptions: The options of number fields: min and max (and those of every field).
GeometryOptions: The options of geometry and geography fields (PostgreSQL with PostGIS): the shape and the SRID of the column.
DateTimeOptions: The options of datetime fields: autoNow (set to now on every save) and autoNowAdd (when created).
DecimalOptions: The options of decimal fields: precision (digits in all) and scale (decimal places). Values are strings with the places of the scale ('3' is '3.00'); more digits or places are a validation error, as in Django.
OnDelete: What deleting an object does to the objects whose foreign key points to it, done by the ORM: cascade (deleted too), setNull, protect (the delete is refused: ProtectedError) or doNothing.
DbOnDelete: The ON DELETE of the foreign key constraint in SQL databases, done by the database (dbOnDelete).
ForeignKeyOptions: The options of a foreign key: onDelete, relatedName (the reverse relation of the model it points to), attname (the name of the key), and dbOnDelete and dbOnUpdate for the constraint in SQL databases.
EncryptedOptions: The options of encrypted fields: deterministic (found by equality, can be unique), acceptPlaintext (values written before the field was encrypted), and context (the table and column the text is bound to).
ManyToManyOptions: The options of a many-to-many field: relatedName, and through (the model of the links, with fields of its own).
ForeignKey: A foreign key: the key of an object of another model (or of its own: 'self'), in <name>Id, and the object in <name> once loaded.
ManyToManyField: A many-to-many relation: links between the objects of two models, in a table of links (made, or the model of through).
Nullable: Whether the options of a field say null: true.
ModelRef: A model, as a field names the one it points to: its class, a function that gives it (for models defined later), 'self', or its name.
fields: The fields of models: string, text, integer, bigint, float, decimal, boolean, date, datetime, json, uuid, bytes, array, hstore, geometry, geography, encrypted, blob and blobInfo, and the relations foreignKey and manyToMany.
ValueOf: The value of a field in its objects (its type, or null when the field takes null).
NotRequired: Whether a value of a field may be left out when an object is made: it takes null, has a default, is computed or set by the ORM.
PropertyOf: The property of a field in the JSON Schema of a model: optional when it is not required, its type with null when it takes null.
SchemaPropertyOf: The property of a field in the JSON Schema of a model (a foreign key as its key: a number or a string).
InSchema: Whether a field is in the JSON Schema of a model: not blobs; not computed fields nor automatic keys in the schemas of input.
PrimaryKeyOf: Whether the fields of a model have a primary key of their own.
SimplifyProps: The properties of a schema, as one object type (for editors).
ModelSchemaProperties: The properties of the JSON Schema of a model (Model.schema()), typed from its fields: those of input (I) without computed fields and automatic keys.
ModelClass: A model class: new Model(data), its meta, its fields, objects (its QuerySets) and its static methods.
ModelOptions: The options of a model (static options): table, schema, ordering, indexes (TTL indexes with expireAfter), primaryKey (composite keys), abstract, database (in Databases), rules, cache, audit, strict and fillfactor.
ModelCacheOptions: The cache of the objects of a model (options.cache): their ttl in ms, and the unique fields they are found by besides the key.
Meta: What the ORM knows of a model (Model.meta): its name, table, fields, primary key and relations.
HookName: The hooks of a model (Model.on(name, fn)), as Django's signals pre_save, post_save, pre_delete and post_delete.
Model: A model: a class with static fields (and options), whose objects are rows of its table (or documents of its collection). Book.objects gives its QuerySets.
Conditions: The conditions of filter(), exclude() and get(): { field__lookup: value }, Q (and, or, not) or a condition inside json fields.
jsonPath: A condition on a value inside a json field by a path of keys and indexes: jsonPath('meta', ['a', 0]).gt(1).
Q: Conditions combined: new Q({ a: 1 }).or({ b: 2 }), and(), or(), not(), as Django's Q objects.
and: Conditions that all hold (as Django's Q(a) & Q(b)).
or: Conditions of which one holds, at least (as Django's Q(a) | Q(b)).
not: Conditions that do not hold (as Django's ~Q(a)).
FExpression: An expression of a field (F): its value with add, sub, mul and div of numbers or other fields.
F: The value of a field in the database, to compare with (filter({ pages__gt: F('chapters').mul(10) })) or update from (update({ views: F('views').add(1) })), as Django's F.
Aggregate: An aggregate of a field: Count, Sum, Avg, Min or Max.
Count: How many values (non-null) of a field, or how many objects with no field: Count(), Count('books'), Count('tags', { distinct: true }).
Sum: The sum of the values of a field (null when there are none).
Avg: The average of the values of a field (null when there are none).
Min: The least value of a field (null when there are none).
Max: The greatest value of a field (null when there are none).
AggregateResult: The values of aggregate(): one for each aggregate, by its name.
QuerySet: A query of the objects of a model: lazy (await runs it), chained (filter, exclude, orderBy, selectRelated...), and with its writes (create, update, delete...), as Django's QuerySets.
MigrationOperation: An operation of a migration: createTable, addField, alterField, renameColumn, sql, run... with its options.
DatabaseOptions: The options of a database: backend (sqlite, postgres, mongodb, memory, fs, or stores of objects), and those of each backend (url, filename, dir...), with audit and cache.
MemoryCacheOptions: The options of a cache in memory: max (keys kept) and ttl (ms).
SharedCacheOptions: The options of a cache shared by the processes of a cluster (through a bus): a name, and those of the memory cache.
LocalCacheOptions: The options of a cache of each process, kept right by invalidations sent through a bus: a name, and those of the memory cache.
FaultOperation: The operations of a database that faults can affect.
FaultOptions: Which operations a fault affects: operations, models, tenants, a rate, after (the first ones pass), times and for (ms).
FailOptions: The options of fail(): the error thrown (or its message), and those of every fault.
FaultRule: A fault in place (db.faults.fail(), delay(), hang(), down()): its kind, how many operations it affected, and remove().
Faults: The faults of a database (db.faults), for tests of resilience: operations made to fail, wait or hang on purpose.
Database: A database: its backend, the models registered in it, sync() and migrations, transactions, the audit log, caches and faults.
CachedFunction: A function whose results are cached (orm.cached()), with invalidate() of some arguments or all.
Tenants: Tenants, each with its own database or databases: config(id) says where, run(id, fn) runs code in one, and the databases of the tenants used last are kept open.
Backend: A backend of the ORM: how the queries of the models run on a kind of database. Extend it for a backend of your own (Database.registerBackend()).
OrmError: An error of the ORM: its code (XUFA_ORM_ERR_*) and the status of HTTP it gives in a route.
ValidationErrorInstance: A validation error: its messages by field (__all__: those of the model), as Django's message_dict.
ErrorClass: A class of errors of the ORM (instanceof works; it can be called without new).
ValidationError: Values that are not valid (400): errors gives the messages by field.
FieldError: A field that the model does not have (in a query, or in the data of an object).
LookupError: A lookup that a field does not take (filter({ name__gt: ... }) on an encrypted field...).
NotFoundError: get() found no object (404), as Django's DoesNotExist.
MultipleObjectsError: get() found more than one object, as Django's MultipleObjectsReturned.
NotRegisteredError: A model used before it is registered in a database.
ModelError: A model defined wrongly (its fields or options).
QueryError: A query that cannot be made (a reverse relation where it cannot be followed, an option that does not go with another...).
ProtectedError: A delete refused: objects with a foreign key of onDelete: 'protect' point to the objects deleted.
BackendError: An error of the database or its driver.
UnsupportedError: What a backend does not do (fragments of SQL in MongoDB...).
UniqueError: A write that breaks a unique field or index (409): the model and the fields.
Keyring: The keys of encrypted fields, by id: the first (or current) encrypts, all of them decrypt (setEncryptionKeys()).
PluginOptions: The options of the plugin of @xufa/http (orm.plugin): the database or tenants (the tenant of each request), connect and close with the app, sync, migrate and expire at start, cancel (reads stopped when the client goes away), the actor and context of the audit log, and the error handler of the errors of the ORM.
ResourceAction: The routes of a resource: list (GET /), get (GET /:id), create (POST /), update (PUT, PATCH /:id) and delete (DELETE /:id).
ResourceOptions: The options of orm.resource(): the actions, the fields given and taken (fields, exclude, writable, readOnly, strict), filters, search and ordering by query string, pagination and page sizes, related objects, the lookup of /:id, auth rules by action, hooks and the OpenAPI document.
